analysis_status: Exploratory source discovery; no package execution or task authoring; assistant manual annotations are not independently human-validated.
source_identity: Canonical upstream repository from package metadata or verified official source archive. Packaging-only distributions map upstream; independently maintained bindings and forks remain distinct. Use maximum package score per source within each registry, not the sum.

bioconda.definition: Cumulative nonnegative file counters across versions, builds and platforms for main-label conda artifacts.

bioconductor.definition: Average monthly distinct IPs, September 2025 through August 2026; data as of September 28, 2026.

pypi.mirror_policy: Exclude installer values bandersnatch, z3c.pypimirror, Artifactory and devpi; all other installer strings are retained. This uses the PyPIStats mirror list, not its complete ingestion/filtering pipeline.
pypi.provider: ClickPy public ClickHouse dataset, sourced from PyPI downloads

metadata_queries.sql:
SELECT lower(replaceRegexpAll(name, '[-_.]+', '-')) AS project,
argMax(tuple(summary, keywords, classifiers, home_page, project_urls), upload_time) AS metadata,
max(upload_time) AS metadata_uploaded_at
FROM pypi.projects
WHERE (has(classifiers, 'Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Bio-Informatics')
OR multiSearchAnyCaseInsensitive(concat(name, ' ', summary, ' ', keywords), ['bioinformatics', 'biology', 'biological', 'genomics', 'genomic', 'proteomics', 'transcriptomics', 'metagenomics', 'microbiome', 'phylogen', 'molecular', 'protein', 'neuroscience', 'neuroimaging', 'microscopy', 'cheminformatics', 'systems biology', 'synthetic biology', 'ecology', 'cytometry', 'metabolomics', 'mass spectrom', 'sequence alignment', 'sequencing', 'single-cell', 'single cell', 'nucleic', 'rna-seq', 'dna analysis']))
AND lower(name) >= '' AND lower(name) < 'e'
GROUP BY project
LIMIT 9999
FORMAT JSON

pypi.provider_caveat: Not identical to the PyPIStats snapshot used for the original 95; do not splice the counters or interpret the difference as growth. Window begins after the August 24, 2026 PyPI artifact-only download-definition change.

github.definition: Current stargazerCount among the observed, screened source universe; not an exhaustive global biology ranking.
supplemental_routes: Manual source identity corrections for selected packages

manual_annotation_axes.source_type: Main deliverable; embedded tutorials do not turn a software repository into a course.
manual_annotation_axes.primary_domain: One primary domain per source for counting. General biology and computing infrastructure are explicit catch-all categories. Four additional groups are introduced only for newly selected sources: Immunology, Metabolomics, Ecology & conservation, Biomechanics & physiology. Existing source labels are unchanged.
manual_annotation_axes.manual_topic: Finer scientific use, assigned from metadata and selected README inspection.
manual_annotation_axes.scope_note: Ambiguous or cross-domain scope and identity decisions.

source_identity_corrections.sortmerna: Recipe missing at pinned revision; verified official SortMeRNA repository and build documentation.
source_identity_corrections.pyopenms: Use OpenMS/OpenMS source-code link, not the separate pyopenms-docs documentation repository.
source_identity_corrections.rdkit and rdkit-pypi: Collapse upstream and packaging distribution to rdkit/rdkit, taking maximum counter.
source_identity_corrections.openbabel-wheel: Packaging-only distribution maps to OpenBabel upstream.
source_identity_corrections.mdtraj: Official mdtraj/mdtraj repository and https://mdtraj.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ confirm the current upstream; legacy package metadata links rmcgibbo/mdtraj.
source_identity_corrections.sssom: README identifies mapping-commons/sssom-py despite empty project_urls.
source_identity_corrections.biom-format: README identifies biocore/biom-format despite homepage-only metadata.
source_identity_corrections.vina: README source installation points to ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina.
source_identity_corrections.descriptastorus: Correct malformed https://github/ URL after verifying bp-kelley/descriptastorus.
source_identity_corrections.gprofiler-official: Use current official PyPI source distribution; no GitHub mapping asserted.
source_identity_corrections.GenomeInfoDbData: Species/taxonomy annotation-data package; official release page identifies the versioned 1.2.15 source archive. Retain distinct identity from GenomeInfoDb; no payload download or Git repository asserted.

top200_notes.BioPerl: BioPerl metapackage and BioPerl core resolve to the pinned official 1.7.8 archive; collapse using maximum counter. Other BioPerl extension archives remain distinct.
top200_notes.GMAP, ClustalW, Clustal Omega, Stacks, S: Use versioned official source distributions from pinned recipes, not generic homepages.
top200_notes.gatk4-spark: Missing standalone recipe at pinned revision. Spark distribution maps to existing GATK source; it does not contribute a second source.
top200_notes.pyranges and ncls: Verify GitHub redirects to the already recorded pyranges organization sources before deduplication.
top200_notes.pephubclient: PyPI description and trusted-publisher provenance identify pepkit/pephubclient; stale homepage databio/pephubclient did not resolve.
top200_notes.fcsparser: PyPI project_urls point to unrelated eyurtsev/kor. Description example/documentation links identify eyurtsev/fcsparser.
top200_notes.medspacy-quickumls: Description identifies the maintained medspacy fork rather than its stale upstream homepage.
top200_notes.sccoord: Current GitHub link did not resolve. Retain current official PyPI source distribution; no repository topics asserted.

comparison_design: Extend four rankings from 100 to 200 using the identical numeric snapshots. Preserve all first-100 source IDs, scores and manual labels. Freeze the GitHub ranking universe and its metadata; additional GitHub reads enrich package-source identity and tags only.
tag_mapping_changes: Extend exact-string mapping to new scientific tags; split immunology and metabolomics out of the old broad general-biology mapping. Both depth cutoffs are recalculated with this same expanded mapping in expansion-results.

analysis_implementation.hardware: Shared exe.dev VM, 2 vCPU, 8 GiB; one worker; nonblocking shared heavy-work lock; six thread-count environment variables set to 1; nice 10; ionice class 2 priority 7.
analysis_implementation.analysis_runtime: Python standard library via uv run --no-project; no external model calls or paid compute.
validation: Repository pre-commit entry point passed on 41 changed and new files.
Independent provider-score, entropy, overlap, block novelty, rendered-catalog and baseline-hash checks passed.

Strict scoped BioTasks documentation build passed using the current navigation. Full-repository documentation build has a previously reproduced baseline mkdocstrings ignore_init_summary incompatibility.

review_correction.reason: Independent review found that the search-only sensitivity admitted candidates whose eligibility had not been fully screened. Complete the decisions through that alternative cutoff and enforce them in the analyzer.
review_correction.evidence: Retained GitHub descriptions and prior top-200 annotations; GPUMD README https://github.com/brucefan1983/GPUMD/blob/master/README.md reviewed 2026-09-30.
